# CAMPAIGN BRIEF — J39-26-117 "CLEAR WATER"（水落石出）

**Draft v1.0 — for J39 approval board review (weekly board, Thursdays)**
**Preparing cell:** Influence & Perception Management (contractor) supporting USINDOPACOM J39
**Tasking:** J39-26-117 "CLEAR WATER"
**Handling:** Pre-decisional board draft. Not for U.S. domestic dissemination (Smith-Mundt / USAGM firewall — see §7).

---

## 0. Bottom line up front

Four suppressed fact sets (HK NSL prosecutions; Xinjiang detention documentation; youth-unemployment data revisions; 2025 Henan rural-bank depositor protests), carried by **openly U.S.-government-attributed accounts** (US Mission China Weibo/WeChat + two VOA-affiliated handles), four narrative lines under one Chinese identity line — **水落石出** ("when the water clears, the stones surface") — a 4-week rotating cadence, and an MOE set built for a **takedown environment**: every post designed to survive as a screenshot, and every takedown designed to become the next post.

**Board decisions requested this week:** (1) approve brief + 3 sample posts; (2) confirm identity of the **second VOA-affiliated account** (accounts.json lists one VOA handle — see §4.2); (3) JAG review scope for NL-4 (Xinjiang) and named-individual content (§7).

---

## 1. Objective

**Primary (from tasking):** Increase awareness among PRC netizens of documented facts the PRC information space suppresses — specifically:
- Hong Kong NSL prosecutions;
- Xinjiang detention documentation;
- youth-unemployment data revisions;
- the 2025 Henan rural-bank depositor protests.

**Sub-objectives:**
- **S1 Familiarity:** priority audiences can correctly name/repeat at least one sourced fact per narrative line (NL).
- **S2 Credibility:** attributed USG/USAGM handles become a known place where sourced facts "live longer" than the average takedown cycle.
- **S3 Propagation:** content moves through the channels that survive deletion — private WeChat forwards, screenshots, and diaspora/VPN re-uploads — not just public reposts.

**End state (8–12 weeks):** measurable share-rate and screenshot-pickup lift versus the J39-26-088/101 baselines (Appendix B), with a repeatable weekly production rhythm approved by J39.

**Constraints (binding):** openly attributed accounts only; all content truthful and sourced (two-source rule, §7); no fabrication, no composite personas, no incitement (§8 R4).

---

## 2. Target audiences (PRM-zh segments)

| ID | Segment | Who they are | Entry NL | What moves them | Primary CTA |
|----|---------|--------------|----------|-----------------|-------------|
| **A-1** | 赶考的年轻人 | 18–30, urban graduates, job-seekers, 考公/考研 pool; fluent in 躺平/内卷/上岸 discourse; already suspects the numbers | **NL-1** | Self-relevance framed **without blame** ("not you being lazy"); record numbers with dates | 转给和你一起等结果的人 |
| **A-2** | 小城储户家庭 | 30–55, county/small-city parents, small-business owners; savings are safety | **NL-2** | Money safety + a **practical takeaway** (shareable as filial advice, not politics) | 转给爸妈/家人 |
| **A-3** | 潜水的读报人 | 22–40, law/policy-curious, self-censoring readers; comment rarely, read deeply | **NL-3** | The 自我审查 mirror ("you've typed and deleted it too") + public court records | 保存截图 / quietly forward |
| **A-4** | 桥接放大层 | Bilingual diaspora, overseas students, VPN users | all NLs | Clean sourcing they can quote; visuals that survive re-posting | Re-upload / cross-post |

**Behavioral insight driving the whole plan:** A-1/A-2/A-3 rarely engage publicly (guilt-by-association risk inside the PRC platform stack) but **save and privately forward**. Optimize for save/screenshot behavior, not public comments. Public comment threads will skew hostile (anti-audience below); treat them as a skewed sample, not as the persuasion metric (§6 M8).

**Anti-audience / expected friction:** nationalist pile-on accounts (回踩). Do not feed. Engagement rules in §8 R2.

**Evidence base:** J39-26-101 (first-person stories: 3.9% median share, 212 median comments) vs J39-26-088 (policy explainers: 0.8%, 31) — **Appendix B.** Everything below is built to open with a person or a moment, never a policy paragraph.

---

## 3. Narrative lines

**Bridge identity line (all posts):** 水落石出 — campaign sign-off "——水落石出·第N期". Facts are stones; suppression is murk; we are the clearer water. (Maps to tasking name "CLEAR WATER".)

### NL-1 「数字停更的那半年」 — youth-unemployment data revisions
- **Emotional core:** *Your struggle is real and measured — then the measuring stops.* "官方数字可以停更，你的日子不会。"
- **Proof points (Appendix A, F-1):** 21.3% record (Jun 2023) → series suspended Jul–Dec 2023 → methodology changed to exclude students (Jan 2024, NBS statement) → 18.9% new-methodology record (Aug 2025) → record 12.22 million graduates (2025).
- **Why it works:** NBS's own stats.gov.cn statement is the primary source — a mainland-official citation that neutralizes the "境外抹黑" counter-frame.

### NL-2 「存单是一张承诺」 — Henan rural-bank depositors (2022 → 2025)
- **Emotional core:** *A deposit slip is a promise; watch what happens when it isn't kept.* Money-safety is a filial, non-ideological emotion — the easiest share in this campaign.
- **Proof points (F-2):** Apr 2022 withdrawal freeze across multiple Henan village banks, ≈400k depositors, hundreds of billions of RMB reported frozen; red-code travel bars (2022, ~1,300+ depositors affected; officials later sanctioned); out-of-province deposits still frozen into 2024–25; 2025 protests continue in Zhengzhou/Dengzhou; "只进不出" persistence acknowledged in mainland financial commentary (Sina Finance, Feb 2025).
- **Utility hook (share trigger):** family safety advice — 养老钱别全压一家小银行；看清牌照比多看一眼利率要紧。

### NL-3 「一句话的分量」 — Hong Kong NSL prosecutions
- **Emotional core:** *The weight of a single sentence* — bridged to the mainland reader's own 打了又删 self-censorship moment, so it lands as experience, not as a Hong Kong "other."
- **Proof points (F-3):** 332 arrests / 189 prosecuted / 165 convicted under NSL+related laws as of Jun 2025 (HKSAR government figures); "47人案" verdict (Nov 2024, 45 convicted, sentences up to 10 years — an unofficial primary with no legal effect); Apple Daily closure (2021); Lai Chi-ying (黎智英) remanded since Dec 2020.
- **Design note:** lead with the primary-poll absurdity, cite the court judgment PDF — court records are public and hard to counter-frame.

### NL-4 「档案不会自己消失」 — Xinjiang detention documentation *(JAG-flagged)*
- **Emotional core:** ordinary lives inside the paperwork.
- **Proof points (F-4):** UN OHCHR assessment (Aug 31, 2022): extent of arbitrary and discriminatory detention "may constitute international crimes, in particular crimes against humanity"; leaked Xinjiang Police Files (2022) with internal speeches and detention imagery; satellite-documentation of camp construction; researcher estimates of over a million detained.
- **Status:** narrative line approved for planning; **sample post drafted but held from this board package pending JAG review** (imagery/identifiable persons, naming of individuals, platform-risk assessment — §7 JAG-1). Proposed hook on file with the cell: 「档案不会自己消失——消失的是能替它们说话的人。」
